title: Megaspeed, the company linked to the downfall of Nvidia boss, says it’s a ‘legitimate and lawful business’
summary_full: Company insists Alice Huang, who is accused of being a Chinese spy, left business in late 2025Elon Musk joins 165,000 others calling for Nvidia to bring back Jensen HuangBusiness live – latest updatesMegaspeed International, the company linked to the downfall of the Nvidia chief, Jensen Huang, says it is a “legitimate and lawful business” and has announced that its director, who allegedly had an affair with Jensen Huang, left the business in late 2025.The Singapore-based cloud computing company on the weekend said it was “aware of recent media reports containing assertions about our business, supply chain and global operations that are not supported by verifiable evidence”.
